sections.h2: A Levy County painting contractor with Williston on the regular route
body: Williston is a small town with a lot of variety packed around it. In one week, painters in Williston, FL can go from a storefront in the downtown core to a farmhouse on open acreage to a house that went up last year along the US-27 corridor. We are based in Newberry, a short drive northeast, and Williston is a stop our crews make often enough that walkthroughs and warranty touch-ups do not need special planning.
We are locally owned with more than 15 years of painting experience, and we are licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida. Every crew member is covered by workers' comp.

sections.h2: What Williston buildings ask of a paint job
body: Around Downtown Williston, the work leans toward older structures and small commercial fronts where layers of past coatings need to be scraped back to a sound edge before anything new goes on. In Williston Highlands and out toward Pine Run, the mix is mostly residential, with siding, trim, and soffits that show their age first on the elevations facing the afternoon sun.

Agricultural properties bring their own list: a main house plus outbuildings, long fence lines, and porches that see more dirt and wear than a typical subdivision home. The new build-outs along US-27 are a different story. Those homes often carry builder-grade flat paint that marks easily and fades early, so the first repaint is where an owner can step up to a better product line.

sections.h2: Humidity, storm season, and the west wall
body: Williston summers keep humidity high for months on end, and afternoon storms roll through several days a week between June and September. Wood swells, open caulk joints let water in behind trim, and shaded walls grow mildew. Meanwhile the south and west faces take the heaviest UV and lose pigment long before the north side does. Our guide to exterior care in North Central Florida goes through the warning signs in more detail.
Because of that, we schedule exterior work in the October through May window whenever we can. In summer, crews start early and keep an eye on the dew point and radar.

If you want the full menu in one place, start with our overview of painting services in Williston. Most homeowners come to us for exterior house painting in Williston, a room-by-room interior repaint, or a combined whole-home residential project. Downtown owners and managers ask about commercial painting scheduled around business hours.

Farm and acreage owners keep our wood crews busy with board fence painting and staining and deck stripping and re-staining. We also offer soft washing and pressure washing, kitchen cabinet refinishing, and in-home color help in Williston.

A crew lead walks the property, measures, photographs conditions, and takes moisture readings where the wood or stucco looks suspect. Walkthroughs are usually booked within 48 hours, and the itemized quote typically arrives within one business day. It names the surfaces included and excluded, the prep steps, the primer and topcoat, the number of coats, and the schedule. Nothing is added later without your written approval.

Most jobs start one to three weeks after approval. Prep comes first: washing, scraping, sanding, mildew treatment, rot and fascia replacement, re-caulking, and spot-priming. Then we apply two full coats of premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore product, adding a third for big color changes or porous surfaces. You sign off at the punch walk, and exterior projects carry a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years.

Williston is one of two Levy County towns on our route. The other is Chiefland, farther west toward the Suwannee. Heading back toward our home base we also paint in Archer and Newberry, and to the south our crews cover Dunnellon. Every county and town is listed on the Levy County service page.

faqs.q: Do you paint farm buildings and fences as well as the house in Williston?
faqs.a: Yes. On agricultural properties we can price the residence, outbuildings, fencing, and decks on one written estimate, with each surface and its product listed separately so you can phase the work if you prefer.

faqs.q: How quickly can someone walk my Williston property?
faqs.a: Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours of your call, and the written estimate generally follows within one business day. Most projects begin one to three weeks after you approve it.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured to work in Williston?
faqs.a: Yes. Precision Paint Experts is licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member. We can provide a certificate of insurance naming your business or association before work begins.

faqs.q: Is it worth repainting a newer home on US-27 so soon?
faqs.a: Often it is. Builder-grade flat paint tends to mark and fade quickly. A first repaint with a 100% acrylic exterior system or a washable interior finish usually holds up much better from that point on.
